build_url_youtube: build a YouTube watch URL from a given YouTube video ID string
run_rem_temp_files: run rem_temp_files to remove all non-JSON temporary files from the .mp directory
run_fetch_songs: run fetch_songs to download audio song archives into the Songs directory
run_choose_random_song: run choose_random_song to select and return the path of a random audio file from the Songs directory
run_close_selenium_instances: run close_running_selenium_instances to terminate any running Firefox/Selenium browser instances
